source_inputs.required_input: The coordinate ring lift requires four actual square equations in a commutative complex algebra.
source_inputs.constructed_input: The algebra is all complex-valued functions on the original regular source; equations are pointwise roots_square.
source_inputs.justification: Only the existing original root equations discharge the lift, not any desired scheme equivalence.

constructed_objects.required_input: The functions must live on the original genus-five domain.
constructed_objects.constructed_input: OriginalRegular is exactly RegularSource, and originalBase/originalRoot are its literal original functions.
constructed_objects.justification: No theta Base tau, target model or abstract field replaces the source.

domain_coverage.required_input: The lift and deck compatibility are whole-ring claims, with every original regular point.
domain_coverage.constructed_input: evaluation/atPoint are AlgHom values on the entire quotient ring; hom_ext promotes exact generator formulas.
domain_coverage.justification: No unsupported generic extension across branch points is claimed; regularity is explicit and exact.

transition_maps.required_input: The original arithmetic deck action must agree with the original labeled root signs.
transition_maps.constructed_input: originalAction uses w smul x with independently proved regularity, and deck_evaluation uses finiteEnd branches (basis w).
transition_maps.justification: The base stays fixed and roots transform by the original basis coordinate, retaining the105/70/42/30 order.

identity.required_input: An evaluation must actually be the original base/root map at each point.
identity.constructed_input: evaluation_base/root and atPoint_base/root state those literal identities; every_regular_algebra_point concludes atPoint x=f on the whole ring.
identity.justification: Equality is not merely an isomorphic replacement of a point, field or chosen generator.

coefficients.required_input: Complex coefficients and quotient relations must remain literal.
coefficients.constructed_input: Native lift uses the same branches and actual Pi algebra scalar map, with constants preserved by atPoint.commutes.
coefficients.justification: There is no rational descent or scalar extension claim.

compatibility.required_input: Realization and equivariance must follow original producers, not assumed model properties.
compatibility.constructed_input: all_roots constructs x and roots/base equality; native hom_ext constructs all-ring equality; original base_action/roots_action construct full-ring deck compatibility.
compatibility.justification: No injectivity or function-field generation assumption is added.

exceptional_cases.required_input: Exclude exactly the four finite branch values for regular realization; preserve all other values and signs.
exceptional_cases.constructed_input: The denominator condition is the existing complete root denominator, and all_roots covers every root tuple over it.
exceptional_cases.justification: Branch/infinity completion is explicitly outside this module, not silently omitted from a claimed whole-curve result.

downstream.required_input: Later injection/normalization needs an honest original evaluation hom, not a renamed target field.
downstream.constructed_input: This source supplies that hom and exact original point/deck identities.
downstream.justification: It is not yet consumed by a proved algebraization theorem. Injection and entire meromorphic-field generation remain separate open obligations, with explicit roadmap.
